content: Send an email to a supervisor requesting time off for a personal matter.

Subject: Request for Personal Time-Off

Dear [Supervisor’s Name],

I am writing this email to request some time-off for a personal matter. I am sorry for any inconvenience that this might cause you and the team.

As you are aware, I have been working very hard in the past few months to meet the project deadlines. However, due to some unforeseen circumstances, I need to take some time off from work. I need to attend to some urgent family matter and I would need to be away from work for a period of [number of days/months].

I understand that this is a crucial time for our team and your project deadlines need to be met. I have already made the necessary arrangements to ensure that my tasks and responsibilities are taken up by my colleagues in my absence. I will also complete all my pending tasks before I leave, so there is no lapse in work.

I would be available on mail and phone during my time-off, in case my assistance or support is needed with anything.

I hope you will consider my request positively, and I appreciate your cooperation in this matter. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to approach me, and I will be more than happy to discuss them.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
